records.name: Jack Fieldnote
records.biography_en: Jack Fieldnote serves with Rifle Detail, a u.s.-inspired infantry detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The olive helmet is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Jack Fieldnote looks steady and observant even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
